review_text: Money was deducted from my bank via Google Pay but the order status says cancelled immediately.
Card payment failed three times during checkout, yet my account got charged twice for the same items.
I have been waiting for the 6-digit SMS verification code for 10 minutes and it never arrived on my Airtel SIM.
After updating to Android 15, the fingerprint biometric scanner throws an unexpected error and closes the app.
The new dark mode update makes white text blend into grey background. I cannot read item descriptions at all.
Whenever I scroll down the product catalog, the screen stutters and freezes for 3 to 4 seconds.
The live GPS delivery rider marker gets stuck on the map and stops updating halfway through delivery.
Applied coupon code FESTIVE50 which showed ₹200 discount, but the final payment gateway screen charged full price.
Auto-read OTP permission failed and the manual submit button stayed greyed out, so I could not sign in.
The app crashed completely right when I clicked 'Proceed to Payment' and my entire cart disappeared.
Search filter for 'Vegetarian Only' is broken; it keeps displaying non-veg items in search results.
The 'Add to Cart' button overlaps directly over the bottom navigation bar on smaller screen phones.
Driver marked order as delivered 15 minutes before actually reaching my location. No customer support chat available.
Face ID recognition hangs forever on iPhone 15 Pro, forcing me to force-close and enter password manually.
Payment gateway times out during UPI intent switch to PhonePe. Had to give up on buying dinner.
Push notifications for order confirmation arrive 45 minutes after the food is already eaten.
Tried placing a bulk grocery order for the weekend, app threw an unhandled 500 internal server error at checkout.
The font size across the settings screen is way too small and does not follow my phone's accessibility settings.
Refund for my damaged order was promised in 2 hours, but it has been 4 days and bank statement shows nothing.
Smooth browsing experience and clean layout, but adding an option to tip the delivery rider would be great.
